caption: The drawing shows a quilt-like composition with a symmetrical arrangement of objects and designs. In the center, there is a large red bird with outstretched wings, holding a green leafy branch in its beak. Surrounding the bird are nineteen red stars of varying sizes arranged in a circular pattern. Above the bird, the letters "C. A. C." are inscribed in red, and below the bird is the year "1853." also in red. The background is a pale beige or cream color. The border is decorated with a repeating pattern featuring circular motifs in red and white with patchwork-style details, each enclosed by segments of green leaves that resemble oak leaves. The entire drawing uses primarily red and green hues for the motifs and lettering, set against the pale background.
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
